<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Car Service" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="L_SYS" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>notify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>fine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>email</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endNotReg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endFined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L_OWN" name="Car owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>wait</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>visit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>late</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>pay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L_MEC" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>repair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>success</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>next</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>endDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Service successful" />
    <bpmn:task id="check" name="Check if the car is still registered" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="reg" name="Car still registered?" />
    <bpmn:task id="notify" name="Notify the car owner" />
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="wait" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="visit" name="Car brought to service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="late" name="30 days passed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition><bpmn:timeDuration>P30D</bpmn:timeDuration></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="fine" name="Fine the car owner" />
    <bpmn:task id="enter" name="Enter the problems of the car" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="split" />
    <bpmn:task id="repair" name="Repair the car" />
    <bpmn:task id="email" name="Send status updates via email" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join" />
    <bpmn:task id="pay" name="Pay through the app" />
    <bpmn:task id="success" name="Enter that the repair was successful" />
    <bpmn:task id="next" name="Enter the time for the next service" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endNotReg" name="Process ended" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endFined" name="Owner fined" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endDone" name="Service completed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="check" targetRef="reg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" name="yes" sourceRef="reg" targetRef="notify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="no" sourceRef="reg" targetRef="endNotReg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="notify" targetRef="wait" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="wait" targetRef="visit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="wait" targetRef="late" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="late" targetRef="fine" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="fine" targetRef="endFined" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="visit" targetRef="enter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="enter" targetRef="split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="split" targetRef="repair" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="split" targetRef="email" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="repair" targetRef="join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="email" targetRef="join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="join" targetRef="pay" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="pay" targetRef="success" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f18" sourceRef="success" targetRef="next" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f19" sourceRef="next" targetRef="endDone" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
